title: claude-code fetch_analytics_user_usage
description: A JSON array of every token-usage row for one user, one daily bucket and one product, each row stored verbatim from GET /v1/organizations/analytics/user_usage_report. The connector checks actor.user_id and starting_at; the other properties are typed from the vendor's documentation.

items.description: One usage row. The vendor fans a bucket out by model.

user_id.description: Anthropic user id. Part of the ExternalID.

starting_at.description: Bucket start, RFC 3339. Its UTC date is part of the ExternalID, and midnight UTC of that date is the DataDate.

product.description: Product the usage belongs to, such as claude_code. Part of the ExternalID; absent, null or empty groups under unknown.

model.description: Model id or display name. Not part of the ExternalID (vendor-documented).

uncached_input_tokens.description: Input tokens not served from cache (vendor-documented).

cache_creation.description: Cache-write tokens by TTL, such as ephemeral_5m_input_tokens (vendor-documented, kept verbatim).

server_tool_use.description: Server tool calls, such as web_search_requests (vendor-documented, kept verbatim).
